name: Calcination
process: Volatile matter driven off by heat

name: Congelation
process: Fluid brought to a solid by cooling

name: Fixation
process: The three principles given their bounds

name: Digestion
process: A substance worked on by liquid and heat

name: Distillation
process: The volatile drawn off from the less volatile

name: Sublimation
process: Solid to vapour and back, never liquid

name: Putrefaction
process: A body disintegrated into its elements

name: Fermentation
process: The leaven worked through the mass

name: Dissolution
process: Substances merged into one homogeneous whole
